description: This file contains code related to Redis reminder options, exceptions, and extensions for Orleans framework integration. It includes partial classes for Redis reminder configuration, validators, exception handling, custom serialization codecs, and extension methods for service configuration.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Redis reminders, including connection settings and a factory method for creating the Redis connection.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the Redis reminder table options to ensure proper configuration.

classes.name: RedisRemindersException
classes.description: Custom exception class for Redis reminders errors.

classes.name: Codec_RedisRemindersException
classes.description: Serialization codec for RedisRemindersException, enabling it to be serialized/deserialized during network communication.

classes.name: Copier_RedisRemindersException
classes.description: Provides deep copying capabilities for RedisRemindersException instances during serialization processes.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default method to create a Redis connection multiplexer based on the provided options.

methods.name: UseRedisReminderService
methods.description: Extension methods to add Redis reminder services to the Orleans silo builder or dependency injection container.
